integrity: Exact proof uses spectral projectors, rational comparison polynomials, Descartes sign patterns, and simple-root convergence. Supplementary SymPy verifier passed 7,082 exact assertions; independent mathematical audit and independent novelty validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: For each fixed integer p at least three, the theorem classifies two noiseless Nyström landmarks on K_{p,q} for sufficiently large q; a finite coefficient-and-midpoint criterion is sufficient for individual sizes. It does not establish the smallest q cutoff or generalize to arbitrary weights, noise, or budgets. An equivalent unpublished or unindexed result cannot be ruled out.
title: Three Nyström landmark phases on highly asymmetric complete bipartite networks
